doc.title: Norris Turney interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997

title: First recordings during the record strike
summary: His first records were with Eckstine during the Petrillo recording strike.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: My first record date: sessions, personnel, discography

blocks.x: When was your first chance to get on record? Was it with Eckstine or even before that?
Yeah, I think it was with Eckstine. It was during the great record strike.
Well I don’t know. We walked up many, many flights of steps to the studio. Petrillo had everybody closed up back in those days.
So those particular recordings you made that day, they probably weren’t released until after the strike was over.
No. They were all on national records.
Did you do any of those V disks?
